column1: # NASSP mission edits: the quantities tools/nassp_edits.py compares between the stock run and ours,
# per milestone, with the tolerance |ours - stock| may reach at the same time since ignition (from
# ignition on). Each tolerance is 1.5 x the stock run's own spread: stock headless at -f 0.02
# against stock headless at -f 0.01, same scenario and script (2026-10-13; the spread comes from
# the host, e.g. a 0.6 s ignition shift over moving terrain, PDI P65 at TIG+630 vs +660 s). A
# quantity out of tolerance is a difference our LGC makes. Events (ignition, cut-off, orbit,
# contact, touchdown) are tabled separately. Columns are those of the edit CSVs that common.lua's
# ac.edits writes (vessel truth from Orbiter, LGC words by address).
